notes.title: Announcement: Evoland Legendary Edition
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4553715/ee5a1b5f2806cf38017d69314dd8234de3ed8494.gif

Interested by Evoland? 

We're glad to introduce you Evoland: Legendary Edition!


Evoland: Legendary Edition is a pack which brings you two great and unique RPGs, with their graphic style and gameplay changing as you progress through the game!

It contains:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4553715/2652a4881ec0f164fefbe6d98a64c92142ce0bc8.png


 Evoland is a journey through the history of action/adventure gaming, allowing you to unlock new technologies, gameplay systems and graphic upgrades as you progress through the game.

 Inspired by many cult series that have left their mark in the RPG video gaming culture, Evoland takes you from monochrome to full 3D graphics and from active time battles to real time boss fights, all with plenty of humor and references to many classic games.



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4553715/46de361097cc7985ffeac1114d35c2e007ffa3fe.png


Evoland 2 graphics style is changing as you travel through time and its gameplay evolves as you move along the storyline. 

 It is also a real RPG at heart, with a deep scenario based on time travel: explore different eras and change the history of the world. But are you sure that the consequences will not make things worse?



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4553715/468c7a5b6d67c04768d8d9a28320782750127531.png

Full of humor and references to classic games, the Evoland series brings a truly epic and extraordinary adventure, unlike anything you’ve ever played before!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4553715/5183467f8856c075296eccace69351aee369b95d.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1020470/Evoland_Legendary_Edition/

notes.title: Minor Game Update
notes.content:
v1.1.2490:
	- overall performances improvements
	- optimized monster path finding in hack n slash level
	- streaming of some big levels
	- upgraded to FP 11.6/AIR 3.8
	- optimized light assignement to reduce shader updates in hack level
	- changed algorithm for point lights in hack level (use normals + multiply)
	- better looking hero ambient lighting in hack level
	- use WinXP dinput8.dll (should prevent some pad.exe crashes on XP)
	- allow heal during bombs quest
	- heal hero when kaeris leave in aogai
	- allow talking to merchant while airship is near
	- fix airship recovery in sacred grove
	- fix hero-in-a-rock when going back to start level
	- few typos
